 Lines 525–6 occur at the foot of p. 103 of Nbk 6; a version of lines 527–30 is written, very small,
at the foot of the preceding, facing page. The section (lines 525–33) is redrafted on p. 109, continued
(lines 533–46) on p. Lines 547ff. begin at the top of p. 104 (BSM xv 107, 113, 121, 109). This sug-
gests S. wrote lines 547ff. first, before the Maniac’s speeches, and left blank pages (perhaps pp. 94–103)
in the nbk for the Maniac. When these were full, he added to the Maniac’s speeches on later pages; first,
on p. 109, a blank page opposite the concluding lines of the draft; later on p. 116 — the drafts on this
page are closer to the printed text. Moreover, pp. 110–15 contain drafts of PU II i 163–208, which must,
therefore, have been written before the drafts of J&M 525–46 were complete, though not necessarily
